description: When you can't find something only the person knows, ask it here instead of guessing or stopping: it waits on their Home with the right input, they answer it in one tap, and the answer is written for you (no call back). Kinds: percent_off, code, ends_at, link_picture (subject_id: a link); caption, hashtags, cover (subject_id: a post; account_id for one account's version; hashtags come with suggestions ranked by how past and competitors' posts with each did); deal_rate (subject_id: a deal); voice (voice_field); question (title, optional choices, for anything else, such as which hook or photo to use; read the answer with tasks_list). Asking the same thing again updates the open task. Refused when the field already has a value, when 20 wait already, or when they said they don't know in the last 30 days. Keep working on everything else meanwhile, and tell them in one line that it's on Home.

account_id.description: caption, hashtags, cover: the account this version is for. Leave out to write the post's own caption for every account

detail.description: Why you need it, one or two lines

draft.description: caption, voice or question: a starting point they may keep or change. Leave out to let them start from empty

due_at.description: When you need it by (a post's time)

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

multiple.description: question with choices: they may tap several

reference_id.description: question: the style reference it's about; the picks are saved on its note as what they like

subject_id.description: The link, post or deal it's about

title.description: The question in their words. Written for you except for question

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: task_ask
title: Ask the person on Home
